patch_plan: Smallest safe patch: add a single opt-in env gate and CLI flag to send_cold_outreach_v2.py so it can cap sends to one lead without changing _small_wave_send_run.py. Exact change: 1) in automation/send_cold_outreach_v2.py, add `argparse` handling for `--max-sends` with default 0; 2) after adapter enables send, enforce `max_sends = int(os.environ.get('ZION_SEND_MAX', '0'))` and break after 1 successful send; 3) require explicit opt-in via `ZION_SEND_ADAPTER=1` plus either `ZION_SEND_ADAPTER_TRIGGER=manual` or `LIVE_SEND_ALLOW_SEND=1` with `DRY_RUN_OUTREACH != 1`, keeping the existing fail-closed default. Wrapper command for 1-lead live send: `cd /Users/miami2/zion.app && ZION_SEND_ADAPTER=1 ZION_SEND_ADAPTER_TRIGGER=manual python3 automation/send_cold_outreach_v2.py --max-sends 1`. No patch needed for lead-crm/_small_wave_send_run.py because it already defaults to `ZTG_SEND_COUNT=1` and fails closed with `ZTG_SEND_ALLOWED=0`. Required env/config changes: - automation: set `ZION_SEND_ADAPTER=1` and `ZION_SEND_ADAPTER_TRIGGER=manual` only for this test run; do not change defaults in config. - lead-crm: no change required for the tested path. - ensure `lead-crm/outreach_ready_canonical.json` has at least one ready lead with a non-empty `email`. Verification steps: 1) Run `cd /Users/miami2/zion.app && SEND_DRY_RUN=1 ZTG_SEND_COUNT=1 python3 lead-crm/_small_wave_send_run.py` and confirm stdout shows send blocked/disabled and success_count=0. 2) Run the wrapper live-1 command above against a known test lead; immediately inspect `outreach-send-log-campaign.jsonl` and `lead-crm/outreach_sent_history.jsonl` and confirm exactly 1 new `status=sent` entry and no additional sends. 3) Confirm `send_cold_outreach_v2.py` exits after the first successful send when called with `--max-sends 1`, with stdout `Resumo do cold outreach` showing `Enviados com sucesso : 1`. 4) Confirm default run without wrapper variables still fails closed and does not send. 5) Confirm no other emails were sent by checking recent Gmail sent items and comparing to prior sent-history line count.
verification_steps: Run dry-run wrapper for small-wave path: cd /Users/miami2/zion.app && SEND_DRY_RUN=1 ZTG_SEND_COUNT=1 python3 lead-crm/_small_wave_send_run.py; verify stdout indicates send blocked/disabled and success_count=0.

Run the 1-lead live wrapper for v2 path: cd /Users/miami2/zion.app && ZION_SEND_ADAPTER=1 ZION_SEND_ADAPTER_TRIGGER=manual python3 automation/send_cold_outreach_v2.py --max-sends 1; verify exactly one successful send in outreach-send-log-campaign.jsonl and lead-crm/outreach_sent_history.jsonl.
Inspect summary output of the v2 run and confirm Enviados com sucesso = 1 and no additional iteration logs beyond 1 send.
Confirm default behavior remains fail-closed: run cd /Users/miami2/zion.app && python3 automation/send_cold_outreach_v2.py and verify send_disabled entries appear instead of sends.
Verify no extra real emails were sent by checking Gmail Sent Items and comparing outreach_sent_history.jsonl line count before/after; delta must be 0 or 1 only.
